ops.title: fileproviderd stall: domain registration acked but creation deferred (acct-14 incident)
ops.body:
2026-07-08 ~00:37: `ccp add` (acct-14) failed after 42m49s with fusekit's "file provider domain did not serve an enumeration in time". Live-state + code forensics established a distinct macOS failure class:

**Registration ack != creation.** The companion app's NSFileProviderManager.add() completion fired (domain listed in getDomains), but fileproviderd did not actually process the domainCreation until 02:02:02 — 85 minutes after registration and 42 minutes after the CLI gave up. Once created, the domain enumerated fine. No crash reports; all 10 pre-existing domains stayed healthy throughout — the stall gated NEW-domain creation only. Machine never slept (pmset log). macOS 26.5 (25F71).

**Remove-ack under stall is not removal.** fusekit Setup's rollback Remove no-ops ok:true when the pending add is not yet in fileproviderd's list, and a timed-out add is never cancelled OS-side — the deferred creation lands anyway, resurrecting the domain as an orphan (CloudStorage dir + live appex, no accounts row, no backing dirs). The daemon then spam-reads the missing private root via the bridge.

**Where the 42m went**: waitDomainServes is hard-bounded (~8.5 min: 2m contact + 6m serve). The only unbounded call in the chain was `open -g` (launchApp, context.Background()) — probable but unproven sink for the other ~34 min (unified logs rotated before capture).

**Fixes**: fusekit v0.35.0 — bounded app launch (30s default, LaunchTimeout knob), RemoveConfirmed (stable-absence x3 polls + one re-Remove + ErrDomainRemovalUnconfirmed joined with last error/ctx.Err), per-phase elapsed in Setup errors. cc-pool v0.49.0 (77f03928) — ccp add rung diagnosis + orphan-materialization note, doctor orphan-domain detection with doubly-evaluated predicate and --fix removal, PrepareAdd atomic private-root claim (os.Mkdir) + fresh-failure cleanup, status consent footer.

**Rules**: never trust a remove-ack issued while fileproviderd is stalled; an orphan domain can materialize hours later — reconciliation (ccp doctor --fix) is the only reliable closure. When an FP wait times out mysteriously long, suspect the app-launch path first; Setup errors now carry per-phase timings to disambiguate.
ops.when: debugging FP domain enumeration timeouts, ccp add file-provider setup failures, orphaned CloudStorage domains, or fileproviderd acting wedged
